recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reintroduce the old DSTU1 ShareableValueSet-specific wording into current core; if profile-specific validation rules are desired, raise them against the current profile/pattern owner.
issue_request: FHIR-5800 asked whether servers may validate logical code system references during PUT/POST and requested an explicit note that servers can do so, plus Shareable ValueSet guidance that servers should validate such references.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn revision 5691, now commit cac052b66cfc5ab1173ee363c0fce9781471f7d9, which added validation comments to old valueset-spreadsheet.xml and valueset-shareable-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: Those DSTU1/R2 spreadsheet artifacts were later removed from active current source during the 2021 CodeSystem/ValueSet source rework. Current active core source includes CodeSystem and ValueSet resources and the Shareable logical pattern, but not an active core ShareableValueSet profile definition to patch. Later FHIR-38833 also directed shareable and publishable profiles toward CRMI for updates and corrections.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current CodeSystem.url requires a globally unique canonical that should be a literal address for an authoritative instance, ValueSet.compose.include.system points to Coding.system for correct system identifiers, Coding.system requires an unambiguous code system URI, and terminology-service.html says terminology servers should validate incoming resources and ensure integrity.
